authorship: Derived from each seed's own frozen shared_features_with_key, why_plausible_for_this_decision and correctness-condition text, joined to the frozen canonical stem-feature vocabulary of its target's anchor study unit. Anchors are stem-independent: no opportunity, scenario, stem, lead-in, key, option or G2 verdict is referenced by any derivation. The seed pack and its enrichment are unchanged.

derivation_rules.R1: every correctness condition requiring a feature PRESENT is an anchor.
derivation_rules.R2: a phrase in the seed's frozen prose contributes the canonical stem features it designates.
derivation_rules.R3: a phrase naming only the option category, the decision point or the presenting complaint designates nothing.
derivation_rules.R4: a seed whose plausibility rests entirely on category membership carries an empty anchor set and is admissible against no stem.
